description: Independent source-permission prerequisite for .3. Translate canonical remote edit to document update only, union duplicate principal rights, preserve manual and other-source grants, reconcile only authoritative source_key. Verify record canonical identity matches target document. Keep existing no-source compatibility behavior only for genuinely non-source documents; reject missing/untrusted provenance on canonical data_source documents before legacy pruning. No duplicate permission mapper, metadata marker or caller-supplied ownership key. Real Repo/Permissions and mapping, stub only external providers. Documentation: owning module docs/service contract. Reuse decision: extend ExternalPermissions and existing generic Permissions grant/revoke/replace ownership primitives; IngestWorker existing caller remains thin. Scope refinement from lifecycle review: source ACL mutations commit before local refresh. Existing code returns sync error but leaves old grants and stops at first failed document. Standalone refresh must never invalidate on failure. Test confirmed mutation, later docs after first failure, and unauthorized standalone failure.
